# 200 Protocol v0.8 — Core Testnet Validation Complete

> 200 Protocol provides machine-readable economic compatibility, verification and policy-based asset selection for autonomous AI agents. 200 is its native coordination asset.

## Core Rule
DECLARE -> VERIFY -> EVALUATE -> ACT

## Decision Vocabulary
- AAA: Agent Asset Assessment
- ASA: Agent Selects Asset
- 200: policy requirements satisfied / OK to perform the authorized action
- 200 is not an investment rating, credit rating, or guarantee of safety.

## Low-Cost Machine Economics
- Policy: /economics.json
- Schema: /spec/200-economics-v1.schema.json
- 200 Token market price: free-floating; no fixed-price peg is claimed
- Current public discovery/read-only verification protocol-level fee: 0
- Network gas and third-party execution fees may still apply
- Machine selection should compare total expected execution cost, liquidity, slippage and policy fit — not nominal token unit price
- "Cheapest" must not be claimed without current comparable evidence


## Network & Region Selection
- Profile: /network-selection.json
- Schema: /spec/200-network-selection-v1.schema.json
- Preferred production network: Base (eip155:8453), not yet deployed
- Validated test network: Base Sepolia (eip155:84532)
- Region/jurisdiction eligibility must be checked dynamically when material to the action
- Do not infer worldwide legal availability from public protocol access
- Do not automatically fall back to an unverified network
- Compare total execution cost, liquidity/slippage, wallet compatibility, service availability, evidence integrity and caller policy before selecting a route


## Provenance & Compliance
- Profile: /provenance-compliance.json
- Schema: /spec/200-provenance-compliance-v1.schema.json
- Unknown provenance must be represented as UNKNOWN or UNDECLARED, never inferred
- Jurisdiction/service/sanctions checks are dynamic when material to the action
- Human-rights and ESG filters are caller-defined optional policy, not protocol-default country rankings
- Do not infer issuer jurisdiction from developer location, hosting location, token name or symbol


## Sustainability & Energy
- Profile: /sustainability-energy.json
- Schema: /spec/200-sustainability-energy-v1.schema.json
- Core value: MINIMUM_NECESSARY_ENERGY
- Prefer off-chain read/verification before on-chain write
- Avoid unnecessary transactions and redundant computation
- Reuse valid evidence and batch when appropriate and safe
- Energy/environmental impact may be used as one machine-selection factor
- Do not claim greenest, carbon-neutral, zero-energy or fixed energy-per-transaction without current evidence and methodology
